name: astack
description: pstack, decoupled from Cursor for Claude Code and Codex, with per-role model configuration, a tracker adapter, and Anatolii's own work skills.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous agent workflows: the rigor router, principles, review panels, ticket work
interface.longDescription: pstack's workflow stack — the rigor router, the principle skills, architect/arena/interrogate design panels, swarm verification, how/why code archaeology — decoupled from Cursor so it runs natively on Claude Code and Codex. Adds per-role model configuration via setup-pstack, a tracker adapter via setup-tracker that keeps every organisation-specific value out of the plugin, plus Anatolii's own work skills: task-interview, pick-next, merge-brief and weekly-report.
defaultPrompt: Use rigor to work this task end to end.
Use setup-pstack to configure which model each role runs on.
Use setup-tracker to configure my issue tracker.
Use task-interview to clarify this task through an adaptive interview.
Use pick-next to choose what to work on next.
Use merge-brief before I merge this MR.
Use weekly-report to write my section of the weekly status.
